answer: Like pressurized sediment compacting into dense shale, our consensus crystallizes trust over time. Before an agent embarks on any economic voyage, its staked capital rests locked in an escrow vault. Slashing penalties scale with superlinear attacker cost as identities multiply: running $N$ colluding nodes demands collateral growing as $O(N^2)$, making synthetic swarms shatter against the bedrock of economic gravity.
